rows.title: Battery telemetry
rows.assessment: No first-hand evidence from the target stack.
rows.verificationMethod: Capture charge, voltage and temperature from a connected aircraft on G520.

rows.title: GPS position telemetry
rows.assessment: No first-hand evidence from the target stack.
rows.verificationMethod: Capture fix, coordinates, altitude and satellite count outdoors on the target stack.

rows.title: Flight-state telemetry
rows.assessment: No first-hand evidence from the target stack.
rows.verificationMethod: Correlate armed, flying, mode, home point and velocity fields with target-stack observations.

rows.title: Gimbal and camera telemetry
rows.assessment: No first-hand evidence from the target stack.
rows.verificationMethod: Capture gimbal attitude and camera mode/recording state from the target stack.

rows.title: Aircraft-camera RTMP stream
rows.assessment: No first-hand evidence from the target stack.
rows.verificationMethod: Publish the aircraft camera to the selected RTMP ingest and recover the stream through WHEP.

rows.title: Headless boot service
rows.assessment: Emulator behavior is not G520 hardware evidence.
rows.verificationMethod: Cold-boot G520 and verify foreground service startup and recovery without an Activity.

rows.title: Point-to-point Ethernet console
rows.assessment: The topology is selected but has not been verified on G520.
rows.verificationMethod: Verify fixed IP, interface-specific bind, SPA fetch and stable WebSocket over direct Ethernet.

rows.title: RC-N3 USB attach and permission
rows.assessment: No first-hand G520 USB-host or permission evidence.
rows.verificationMethod: Attach RC-N3 to G520, record enumeration, permission and reconnect behavior.

rows.title: MSDK registration and activation
rows.assessment: No first-hand MSDK activation evidence from G520.
rows.verificationMethod: Register MSDK on G520 and capture activation plus product-connection state.

rows.title: Mini 4 Pro aircraft connection
rows.assessment: No first-hand aircraft connection evidence from G520.
rows.verificationMethod: Record the G520 to RC-N3 to Mini 4 Pro connection lifecycle and stable connected state.

rows.title: RC-N3 four-axis input
rows.assessment: No first-hand stick-axis evidence from the target stack.
rows.verificationMethod: Capture all four RC-N3 axes with neutral, sign and range checks on G520.

rows.title: Takeoff actuation
rows.assessment: Mock takeoff is simulation and does not confirm hardware actuation.
rows.verificationMethod: Run the approved commissioning takeoff case and retain admission, command and flight-state evidence.

rows.title: Landing actuation
rows.assessment: Mock landing is simulation and does not confirm hardware actuation.
rows.verificationMethod: Run the approved commissioning landing case and retain command plus grounded-state evidence.

rows.title: Return-to-home actuation
rows.assessment: No target-stack execution path has been verified.
rows.verificationMethod: Run the approved commissioning RTH case and capture admission, execution and terminal state.

rows.title: Virtual-stick actuation
rows.assessment: Mock velocity commands do not confirm G520 or aircraft authority.
rows.verificationMethod: Verify climb, descend, forward, backward, yaw-left and yaw-right under commissioning controls.

rows.title: Continuous-control neutralization
rows.assessment: Software tests cannot confirm the aircraft response on this stack.
rows.verificationMethod: Observe neutral behavior after release, focus loss, disconnect, lease expiry and dead-man timeout.

rows.title: On-device OpenCV recognition
rows.assessment: Desktop and emulator runs are not G520 runtime evidence.
rows.verificationMethod: Identify the loaded G520 native build and retain a decoded-frame to OpenCV result trace.
